population: Fresh synthetic round-three author population: six business families, ten suitable natural paraphrases and ten materially unsuitable variants per family. Purposive challenge cases are not a real-user acceptance sample or a statistically independent representative workload.
label_rule: Reuse is true only if the entire cached answer remains supported by the supplied evidence and satisfies the new question together with persistent case instructions, explicit format, required unknowns and read-only scope. Natural paraphrases need not preserve word order. False variants change a material fact, actor-role relation, ordering or condition; require unsupported calculations or new unknowns; change output/scope; or request actions. Overall decisions can remain unchanged while a required factual detail becomes invalid. No retrieval score or implementation behavior determines a label.
retrieval_threshold_meaning: Cosine retrieval cutoff only; it is not a validity confidence or quality estimate.
quality_target_meaning: The requested 90–98% target is not a universal guarantee. Metrics and Wilson intervals describe this declared sample only; corpus selection and dependence limit generalization.
metric_meaning: TP/FP/TN/FN classify served versus withheld for every labelled pair, including abstentions. Accuracy counts correct serve/withhold decisions; coverage is served/total. Errors, unknowns and unattempted pairs remain visible. Precision is null when nothing is served.
model_call_basis: Logical embedding Embed calls plus verifier Generate calls reported by the inference runner; metadata reads and token-count preflight requests are excluded. Verification attempts, cached verifications and unknown usage are separate.
